scope: Controlled graphical host and directly tested local presentation/storage components, not a complete Atoll fork. No DynamicNotch source has been copied into this host.

files.modifications: Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Injected-environment capture lifecycle: one capture at a time, permission gating without hiding islands, hide/restore exactly once on success, cancel and failure, error classification without image contents. Window/display capture (0.4.0): selection returns a CaptureTarget (region or window) passed through to capture.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Pure region-selection math: drag normalization, clamping to the starting display, minimum size, AppKit-to-Core-Graphics global coordinate conversion. Inverse Core Graphics-to-AppKit rect and point conversions for window highlighting and hit-testing.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Carbon RegisterEventHotKey wrapper for the Control-Shift-4 capture shortcut; receives only its own combination, no Accessibility or Input Monitoring permission; explicit register/unregister.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Propagate hover preference changes to existing display presenters immediately. M2 capture increment (0.2.0): capture shortcut lifecycle tied to start/stop and its setting; capture flow wiring, island hide/restore, peek after capture, Copy/Remove/Clear, thumbnails, status messages, and export cleanup at launch and every 30 minutes while running. Drag-out increment (0.3.0): selection state, drag flow wiring to ShelfStore.beginFileDrag/endDrag, shelf hold across presenters, export-capacity messages. Wire capture targets.

Adapted getClosedNotchSize measurement ideas into pure display inputs and screen-relative layout; added external floating capsule placement and size bounds. Test-driven fix: preserve menu-bar clearance by bounding panel height below its top edge; compress margins on synthetic tiny frames. Menu-bar clearance: place both complete window rectangles below the maximum safe-area, visible-frame and explicit menu-height band; bound compact/expanded bodies to usable space, and reject unusable geometry. Camera width is metadata, not a content spacer. Notch-sized placement (0.1.3): replaces the below-menu-band placement, which covered application content. On notched displays the compact window equals the public camera-housing rectangle at the top edge, which holds no menus or status items; implausible housing metadata falls back to a bounded width. Non-notched displays use a small pill inset inside the menu-bar center. Only the user-opened expanded state extends across the menu row; expanded content starts below the housing.

files.modifications: Adapted nonactivating panel configuration; replaced upstream managers with per-display presenter and shared local coordinator; removed capture/defaults registration and global services. Extracted original local presentation state into separately tested IslandPresentation.swift. Hover responsiveness: one stable native tracking host per panel, reconcile the actual cursor after events/show/resize, stop tracking before hide/close, and apply preference changes immediately. Refresh public screen/status-bar geometry on show/update/expansion and hide an unusable layout before activating native tracking; menu-row pixels contain no island window. Notch placement (0.1.3): panel level above status items so an open island draws over the menu row; explicit mouse-event receipt for the visually empty notch target; pointer reconciliation includes the display's top edge. Peek entry point for post-capture acknowledgement. Hold entry point that reconciles the pointer before release.

files.modifications: Extracted locally written presentation state from panel controller; injectable cancellable delay scheduler and stale-callback guard for deterministic race tests. Hover responsiveness: deduplicate unchanged pointer/preference inputs; use 80ms entry and 120ms exit waits; immediately cancel disabled hover work and reset hidden presenters. Peek state: opens briefly, held while the pointer is on it regardless of hover setting, closes after pointer exit, never disturbs an open shelf. Hold state for outgoing drags: pointer exit and hover changes deferred while held, re-evaluated on release; reset on suspend.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Native presenter owns hover events; SwiftUI content animation shortened to 120ms, respecting Reduce Motion. Move compact tray/Shelf/count content below the system menu band and remove camera-gap and extra notch-height content padding. Notch placement (0.1.3): compact notch state draws no visible content; non-notched compact state is a tray/count pill; expanded content is inset below the camera housing. Shelf tiles with thumbnails, time, Copy/Remove; Capture and Clear header buttons; status message line. Tile drag overlay, selection highlight and selected accessibility trait. Capture button and empty-state text describe region, window and screen capture.
Retained production drawing implementation and license header; added provenance and removed editor-only #Preview block.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. On-demand ScreenCaptureKit SCScreenshotManager.captureImage(in:) region capture encoded to in-memory PNG; no disk, pasteboard, preference change or continuous stream. Screen Recording request with a settings-pane fallback; ImageIO thumbnails. Single-window capture via SCContentFilter(desktopIndependentWindow:) at the display's point-pixel scale, without the cursor. Window capture runs outside the main actor so non-Sendable ScreenCaptureKit content never crosses isolation (Xcode 16.4 CI compatibility).
